fields.description: Stored 16-bit checksum of the save image. Recomputed by FUN_0805c778 over the image body on every boot verify (FUN_0805b8bc), and re-stored at image word 0 by FUN_0805c510 (init), FUN_0805bbd4 (entry write) and FUN_0805be8c (record write). Custom table-driven CRC (table/seed are ROM-resident words, not recoverable from code-only decomp), so it is exposed as data rather than a checksums[] spec. Baseline logical value 0xa521.
fields.evidence: FUN_0805c778 recomputes the u16 over the save image (called by FUN_0805b8bc for verify and by FUN_0805bbd4 / FUN_0805be8c before store); FUN_0805c510 inits the 512-byte image at DAT_0805c610 and stores the result at words [0..1]; EEPROM logical bytes [0..1] read 0x21 0xa5 in baseline.
fields.name: header_checksum

fields.description: Player 1 profile name, first 8 characters of the 32-byte player record. 0xFA in the first byte marks an empty/unused slot (fresh save); any other value is the first name character. Text is entered through the FUN_0806043c glyph-buffer path and persisted with FUN_0805be8c; FUN_08061e24 / FUN_08062168 load it with FUN_0805c7bc and fall back to an 8-byte ROM default name when the slot is empty (FUN_0805c7e8 returns 0 when byte0 == 0xFA).
fields.evidence: FUN_0805be8c writes 0x20 bytes at EEPROM blocks 0x36+idx*5 (idx 0 => logical bytes [0x1B0..0x1D0)); FUN_0805c7bc reads the same 0x20 bytes back; FUN_0805c7e8 tests record byte0 != 0xFA for slot 0; FUN_08061e24 copies an 8-byte ROM default name and strips trailing bytes below 0x21 from index 7 down.
fields.name: player1_name

fields.description: Remaining 24 bytes of the 32-byte player 1 record (bytes 8..31). Written/read as part of the same 0x20-byte record by FUN_0805be8c / FUN_0805c7bc (extended text-buffer bytes from FUN_0806043c, zero-padded); all zero in the default save. No per-offset semantics visible in decomp, so kept as opaque bytes.
fields.evidence: FUN_0805be8c writes the full 0x20-byte record at logical bytes [0x1B0..0x1D0) via 4 EEPROM blocks; FUN_0805c7bc reads the same span; FUN_0806043c fills record bytes [0..29) from the text-entry glyph buffer. Baseline bytes [0x1B8..0x1D0) are all zero.
fields.name: player1_record_tail

fields.description: Player 2 profile name, first 8 characters of the 32-byte player record. Same empty/full convention as player 1 (first byte 0xFA = empty). Saved with FUN_0805be8c slot index 1 and loaded with FUN_0805c7bc slot index 1; FUN_08062168 manages the slot-1 text entry and save-back.
fields.evidence: FUN_0805be8c writes 0x20 bytes at EEPROM blocks 0x3B..0x3E (idx 1 => logical bytes [0x1D8..0x1F8)); FUN_0805c7bc reads the same span; FUN_0805c7e8 tests record byte0 != 0xFA for slot 1; FUN_08061e24 / FUN_08062168 apply the same 8-byte default/strip logic to slot 1.
fields.name: player2_name

fields.description: Remaining 24 bytes of the 32-byte player 2 record (bytes 8..31). Same handling as the player 1 tail; all zero in the default save.
fields.evidence: FUN_0805be8c writes the full 0x20-byte record at logical bytes [0x1D8..0x1F8) via 4 EEPROM blocks; FUN_0805c7bc reads the same span. Baseline bytes [0x1E0..0x1F8) are all zero.
fields.name: player2_record_tail

magic_signatures.description: Four constant init bytes written by FUN_0805c510 at image offsets [2..5] (0x0D 0xA8 0xF7 0x81); verified against logical bytes of baseline.sav.
